organization.name: Smallpdf AG
organization.notes: About dates Smallpdf origin to 2013. Checked company/pricing sources do not establish equity investors, financing model or complete current ownership; no bootstrap inference.

pricingTiers.name: Pro
pricingTiers.notes: Paid Pro exists; numeric prices render ellipses in extracted page. Free limited-access tier also offered.
No public designation or amount established from checked pricing page.

pricingTiers.name: Team
pricingTiers.notes: 2–19 seats, centralized billing and member management; numeric price not rendered.

pricingTiers.name: Business
pricingTiers.notes: Closest larger-organization tier; custom offer for 20+ users, not named Enterprise.

moats.claim: Broad PDF task coverage and high user familiarity can defend distribution, though individual utilities are readily substitutable.

productReasons.claim: OCR and editable text go beyond page arrangement.
Strong compression and batch document tools handle repeated file-processing work.
Integrated signature tools combine document preparation and signing.
